ModuleTitle.helper: Used by OpenContent and DNN module settings. This is not displayed to site visitors.

ModuleAnchor.helper: Optional. Creates a page anchor for direct links to this section. Use only letters, numbers, and hyphens.

SectionTitle.helper: Optional. Add the main heading displayed above the journey. HTML is allowed and will render as entered.
SectionTitle.placeholder: A clear path from start to finish.

SectionDescription.helper: Required. Introduce the journey in one or two short sentences. HTML is allowed and will render as entered.
SectionDescription.placeholder: Explain what visitors can expect at each step.

Items.label: Items
Items.helper: Add at least three items. The template displays only the first three or four items, based on the Steps template setting; additional saved items remain available for later use.

Title.helper: Required. Add a short, clear name for this step. HTML is allowed and will render as entered.

Description.helper: Required. Briefly explain what happens in this step. HTML is allowed and will render as entered.
Description.placeholder: Help visitors understand what happens at this stage.

Icon.helper: Required. Find icons at FontAwesome. Example: fas fa-building

IconColor.helper: Choose the icon and outline color. Default uses the current theme text color.

CardLink.helper: Optional. Select a local page or enter a complete http or https URL. When provided, the entire step becomes a link.

SectionFooter.helper: Optional. Add a short note below the journey. HTML is allowed and will render as entered.
SectionFooter.placeholder: Ready to take the next step?
